scope: Primary public metadata reviewed through the web tool, without downloading or training on participant files. These notes are not a checksum verification of the underlying datasets.

sources.title: Investigating motor fatigue using force, EMG, and kinematic data
sources.reported_measurements: Bilateral forearm EMG, hand dynamometer force, Kinarm robot kinematics; three force-intensity rounds.
sources.access_observed: The official page requires registration and login to download or request access.
sources.reason: No unrestricted participant files inspected. Published modalities do not directly provide the current HR/phone sensor input schema. No account was created and no access control bypass attempted.

sources.title: Motion capture data of six jump-landings, fatigued and non-fatigued, after anterior cruciate ligament injury
sources.reported_scale: BORG CR10 before/after a fatiguing protocol
sources.reported_measurements: Optical motion capture, force plates and derived joint angles in six jump-landing tasks.
sources.access_observed: Article describes an open Figshare dataset under CC BY 4.0; participant files were not downloaded in this screening.
sources.reason: Borg is assessed before subsequent jump-landing trials. The 2199 motion trials are not 2199 separate Borg measurements. The described data do not establish a causal HR/phone-to-current-Borg alignment for the present teacher; repeated trials must not be relabeled as independent momentary walking responses. Unlabeled representation transfer could be researched separately.
